12 Easy Fall Diffuser Blends (+ 6 Pre-Made Options)

By Maura in Essential Oils
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 9:12
Instaread

autumn diffuser recipes essential oil recipes fallThis post contains affiliate links. As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases.

There’s nothing like walking into a house that smells like fall. These easy fall diffuser blends fill your home with the cozy scents of cinnamon, clove, orange, and fresh fir, no candles or baking required.

With four kids running in and out all season, I love that a diffuser can make the whole house feel warm and welcoming in minutes. Each blend uses just 3–5 drops of oils you may already have on hand, so you can start mixing today.

I’m sharing 12 of my favorite autumn blends, from Pumpkin Spice Latte to Around the Campfire. I’ve also included 6 pre-made options if you’d rather skip the mixing, plus my tips for using spicy oils safely around kids and pets.

Video Paused

Erika Bragdon is a Certified Essential Oil Coach from the Essential Oil Institute.

Best essential oils for fall diffuser recipes

The different essential oils that I like to use for fall blends tend to fall within four main categories: citrusy, woodsy and earthy, floral, or spicy.

Here are the essential oils I love and recommend for using in the fall.

Citrusy fall essential oils

  • Grapefruit
  • Orange
  • Lemon

Woodsy and earthy fall essential oils

  • Patchouli
  • Vetiver
  • Cedarwood
  • Fir Balsam

Floral fall essential oils

  • Vanilla
  • Lavender

Spicy fall essential oils

  • Cinnamon
  • Ginger
  • Clove
  • Nutmeg

Which essential oil brand is best?

For the best results, you will want to choose a high-quality essential oil brand that is 100% pure and offers third-party testing for quality control. Read more info on how to choose essential oils that work for you and your family (beyond the brand).

My favorite essential oil companies are Rocky Mountain Oils and Eden’s Garden, followed by Ancient Apothecary by Dr. Axe.

Best diffusers to use

In order to fill your home with these amazing autumn aromas, you need a diffuser!

I have several inexpensive essential oil diffusers that I use and recommend, depending on the size and style that you want. If you need a diffuser, check out these options:

  • Small – It’s ideal for small rooms.
  • Medium – Works for slightly larger spaces.
  • Large –  I have this one, and it’s great for bigger spaces.
  • Decorative diffuser – I use this style in my office, and it’s my personal favorite because it’s so pretty!
  • Eden’s Garden diffuser – This one is popular if you prefer one from an essential oil company.

Note: I suggest having more than one diffuser in your home because you may want to utilize different blends in various areas (ex: a different blend in your kitchen from the one you use in your bedroom when you are trying to sleep).

How many drops of oil should I put in my diffuser?

Here’s a general guide of how much essential oil I recommend using in diffusers of different sizes:

  • Small – up to 5 drops of essential oils
  • Medium – up to 7-8 drops
  • Large – up to 10 drops

Note: These recipes are written for small diffusers, but you can increase the number of drops if you prefer a stronger scent.   

A quick safety note: Cinnamon and clove are “hot” oils that can irritate sensitive noses, so start with fewer drops if you’re new to them. Diffuse in a well-ventilated room, run your diffuser in 30–60 minute intervals rather than all day, and keep oils out of reach of little hands. If you have babies, anyone with asthma, or pets (cats especially), talk with your pediatrician or vet before diffusing, and always give pets a way to leave the room.

Best fall diffuser blends

1. Pumpkin Spice Latte

You’ll need 1 drop of EACH of these essential oils:

  • Cinnamon essential oil
  • Orange essential oil
  • Clove essential oil
  • Vanilla essential oil
  • Fir balsam essential oil

2. Autumn Breeze

You’ll need:

  • 2 drops orange essential oil
  • 2 drops clove essential oil
  • 1 drop patchouli essential oil

Note: Patchouli has an earthy, grounding scent that many people find calming. Paired with orange and clove, it smells like a cool fall breeze drifting through an open window.

3. Fall Dreams

You’ll need:

  • 2 drops lavender essential oil
  • 2 drops vetiver essential oil
  • 1 drop cedarwood essential oil

This is my favorite blend for winding down in the evening. Lavender and vetiver are both popular choices for a calm bedtime routine, and cedarwood adds a soft, woodsy note that feels like a crisp fall night.

4. Spiced Cider

You’ll need:

  • 2 drops orange essential oil
  • 2 drops cinnamon essential oil
  • 1 drop ginger essential oil

The combination of citrus, cinnamon, and ginger makes it smell like you have spiced cider in your crock pot, ready to serve. (And maybe we should make some of that too!)

But if you just want your home to have a citrusy, fall-spiced aroma, then go ahead and try this blend in your diffuser.

5. Falling Leaves

Cedarwood and fir balsam smell like a walk through the woods, and a drop of cinnamon warms it right up.

You’ll need:

  • 2 drops cedarwood essential oil
  • 2 drops fir balsam essential oil
  • 1 drop cinnamon essential oil

6. Awaken Autumn

You’ll need one drop of EACH of these essential oils:

  • Orange essential oil
  • Grapefruit essential oil
  • Clove essential oil
  • Cinnamon essential oil

Citrus oils are known for their properties to help awaken.

If you have a busy day ahead of you, go ahead and put this blend in your diffuser first thing in the morning to help energize you and get you moving on your busy fall day.

Note: We use citrus oils in our favorite “Morning Wake-Up” essential oil blend too!

7. Fresh Autumn Air

Bright lemon and orange balance out the spice, so this one feels crisp and clean instead of heavy.

You’ll need:

  • 1 drop lemon essential oil
  • 2 drops cinnamon essential oil
  • 1 drop orange essential oil
  • 1 drop fir balsam essential oil

8. Cozy Back-to-School Blend

As soon as the kids are back in school and the weather cools down, I love filling the house with warm, clean-smelling scents. This spicy, comforting blend is one of my go-tos for fall afternoons when everyone’s home and settling in.

You’ll need:

  • 2 drops Immunity essential oil blend
  • 2 drops cinnamon essential oil
  • 1 drop clove essential oil

9. Cinnamon Spice

This is the one that makes everyone ask, “What’s baking?” It’s warm, spicy, and perfect for a chilly afternoon.

You’ll need:

  • 2 drops cinnamon essential oil
  • 2 drops clove essential oil
  • 1 drop orange essential oil

10. Fall Into Relaxation

This blend helps support relaxation and release stress. You’ll need:

  • 2 drops cedarwood essential oil
  • 2 drops cinnamon essential oil
  • 1 drop orange essential oil

11. Apple Pie

Orange, nutmeg, and cinnamon smell just like a pie cooling on the counter, with zero dishes required.

You’ll need:

  • 2 drops orange essential oil
  • 1 drop nutmeg essential oil
  • 1 drop cinnamon essential oil

12. Around The Campfire

Woodsy fir and cedarwood with a hint of spice. It’s the coziest blend on the list for a fall evening in.

You’ll need:

  • 1 drop orange essential oil
  • 2 drops cinnamon essential oil
  • 1 drop cedarwood essential oil
  • 1 drop fir balsam essential oil

Remember: These blends are just suggested amounts that I have found that work well. Feel free to use them as a great starting place, and don’t let them hold you back from experimenting with your own fun fall diffuser blends!

Already-made fall diffuser blends from Eden’s Garden

If you don’t have many of the oils listed above and don’t want to create your own blends (or want more variety), I recommend trying some pre-made blends from Eden’s Garden.

Check out these 6 awesome options:

  1. Autumn Air
  2. Crumb Coffee Cake
  3. Cozy Cabin
  4. Spiced Chai Latte
  5. Sweater Weather
  6. Friends and Family

FAQ

How many drops of essential oil should I use?
These blends are written for a small diffuser (about 5 drops). For medium diffusers, use 7–8 drops, and for large ones up to 10. Adjust from there based on how strong you like it.

Are fall diffuser blends safe around kids and pets?
Many families diffuse safely with a few precautions: good ventilation, short diffusing sessions, and oils stored out of reach. Hot oils like cinnamon and clove are best used sparingly around little ones. Pets, especially cats, are more sensitive, so check with your vet first.

Can I use these blends without a diffuser?
Yes! Add the drops to a small pot of simmering water on the stove (never leave it unattended), or mix them into a DIY room spray like this DIY Air Freshener Spray with Fall Essential Oils.

What can I use instead of vanilla?
Vanilla is usually sold as an absolute or CO2 extract rather than a true essential oil, so it can be harder to find. Benzoin or a pre-made vanilla blend works well as a swap.
